items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: So we contacted Don Byas and took him on the concert tour with us in Europe

ctx.x: Well, there was the boy in Europe. I'm speaking of Don Byas, something happened and Ben Webster couldn't go in '50 or '51, I think it was. So we contacted Don Byas and took him on the concert tour with us in Europe and, truthfully, Don Byas was a second attraction to that whole band. He played so much tenor that it was a shame, we should've left him home. Yeah, he really took over. Terrific, had known
You (inaudible) Don Byas in this country?
